title: Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) - Digital Database and Corresponding Interfaces for ReUse of Architectural Components (v0.6.1.0)
description:
The Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) is a prototypical digital component database. It catalogs digital representations of uniquely identifiable architectural components for reuse. Furthermore, it provides corresponding interfaces and tools to leverage them via a backend REST-API, a web-frontend as well as a interface for direct interaction within Rhino Grasshopper.

Changes in v0.6.1.0 (2026-10-12)

The first feature release after the cutover (decisions 8.129 to 8.143): a personal profile, datasets that users create and run themselves, revised evidence forms, a swimlane history with export, reinforcement read and written from Grasshopper, designed mails, a privacy page, and a cleaner frontend toolchain. Phase A (the operations part) already shipped as 0.6.0.4. No migration of existing records is needed; one optional maintenance script normalises old reinforcement layouts.

Added

  • Profile (8.133): organisation, ROR id, ORCID (checksum checked), default role and full name in Settings. "I performed this" copies them into an evidence record; the server fills empty fields of a signed-in actor from the profile at write time (a later profile change never rewrites old records). Redaction also blanks the profile.
  • User-created datasets (8.139): every verified account may create up to CSC_MAX_DATASETS_PER_USER (default 3) datasets and moderates them ("Your datasets" in My work, "New dataset"). A new dataset is members-only and unreviewed: until an admin marks it reviewed it cannot become catalogue-wide and its pieces cannot be made public. Only empty datasets can be deleted; the last moderator cannot be removed. Admins get a mail when a dataset is created.
  • Swimlane history (8.140): the History card shows one lane per piece (parents above, children below, cut and assemble links, evidence grouped per day and method) on the new GET /identities/{id}/history; the whole timeline exports as SVG, PNG and JSON.
  • Compact preview and id chips (8.141): one side panel for Browse and the map (rotate and zoom, step through rows); snapshot and record ids to see and copy, also as a Grasshopper panel; ?snapshot=<id> opens that version.
  • Grasshopper (8.133 f, RL6, RL9, RL11): Actor has a Me input that builds the signed-in user's actor from the profile; ReinforcementLayout takes the drawing's link and retrieval date and a ComponentPassport, whose placement maps bars back to stored coordinates; the new FetchReinforcementLayout reads layouts back (one branch per layout, placed like the fetched mesh). Document units are used 1:1 as millimetres, with a warning in other units. The release bundle carries DDU_CSC_GrasshopperInterface_0.6.1.0.gh.
  • Mail templates (8.138 e): the five mails as Jinja2 templates (HTML and text) in the site's colours, without images; an admin page previews every mail and sends a test to the admin's own address.
  • Privacy page /privacy, linked from the footer, the account menu, the registration and the mails; the imprint names the person responsible.
  • Reinforcement bar colours in the viewer by layout or by diameter, with a legend.
  • Corrections of evidence records carry their attachments over (keep or remove); empty document fields of a published reinforcement layout can be filled once (8.142).
  • scripts/db_maintenance/layout_position_none.py (stored region layouts to none), purge_datasets.py (an escape hatch that removes datasets' components without a trace), and .zenodo.json, generated per release (invoke zenodo).

Changed

  • Evidence forms (8.134): numbered sections with an outline, grouped method choice with search, records as a compact table, foldable bars with bulk edits, a check before saving; one shared date field with typing, month and year menus and a year grid (8.143).
  • Edge distance for picked points is measured against the proxy, so bumps in a scan no longer trigger the warning (8.135).
  • Provenance edits include the performers (with "Add me"), method and notes; organisations may carry a link.
  • Anonymous visitors no longer receive the accuracy note of reinforcement layouts; the JSON-LD and the PDF passport carry the photo credit.
  • The site's own logs rotate daily and are deleted after 14 days.
  • Frontend: Next.js 16.4.0, lint packages 16.4 with no errors, no production audit findings; images are served unoptimised and sharp is no longer bundled (its binaries need a newer glibc than the server has).
  • Credits: the DBU and BMBF funding logos and current links.

Removed

  • The HKS curve on the component page and HKS as a component-map basis are hidden (the pooled descriptor carries little meaning; a revised HKS is planned for 0.6.2).
  • The ELK lineage graph (replaced by the swimlane), the unused bcrypt package.

Server notes

  • New Python dependency (jinja2): the deploy builds a new venv. This is the first deploy that re-runs itself with the release's own deploy script.
  • Optional: CSC_MAX_DATASETS_PER_USER in fastapi.ini (default 3).
  • Run layout_position_none.py once (dry run first) to convert old layouts.
  • After the first midnight, check that fastapi.log rotated; send a test mail from Admin > Mail templates and look at it in the usual mail clients.
  • Grasshopper users: run CSC_Update (library csc_gh 261012) for the new and changed components.

Full history: CHANGELOG.md
